newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian GIMV offer closed five days early.
newsitem.headline: Belgian GIMV offer closed five days early.

text.p: Subscriptions to shares in GIMV, the investment company of the Belgian regional government of Flanders to be listed on the Brussels bourse, have been closed early, brokerage Petercam said on Thursday.
Subscriptions were closed at the end of trade on Thursday, five days early. The allocation will be announced in the Belgian press on Saturday. The shares are priced at 2,010 francs each.

The offer, a combined private placement for institutional investors and an initial public offer aimed at private investors, involves a maximum 4,599,770 shares, or 19.9 percent of GIMV's capital. Trading starts on June 26.
GIMV invests in Flemish companies to give them the necessary financial muscle and stamina for international expansion.
Its interests include 33.99 percent of Belgian electronics firm Barco, 9.99 percent of Belgian engineering company BMT and a small interest in Nasdaq-listed software firm Xeikon.

It is a shareholder in Europe's Easdaq growth stocks market and in Belgian telecommunications group Telenet, which aims to convert Flanders' cable television network to provide multimedia and voice telephone services from 1998.
